card.name: Letter p just before "ump" in pump
card.fires_on: The letter p (or hyphen-p) that begins the second part of a split word, most often right before "ump" in pump, as in infusion pump, handpump or proton-pump inhibitors. It also fires weakly on other p-words such as "spew" and "pediatric".

modes.label: Pump compounds
modes.description: The p that starts "pump" after a noun or "proton", often with a hyphen.

modes.label: Capitalized or split p-words
modes.description: A p or " sp" starting another split word, in all-caps text or a brand name.
modes.example: AN INFUSION<< P>>UMP MUST BE USED.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing the word as pump, pumps or pumping.
card.plain: It fires on the letter p when the word "pump" is split up, as in proton-pump inhibitor or infusion pump.
